_comment: M00 / T3.3 - Single source of truth for block definitions.
The block library is BUILT IN CODE from this file by
res://src/adapters/voxel/block_library_builder.gd. Never hand-author a .tres
library in the editor: it must be reproducible from data.
Field notes:
kind              'empty' (no geometry, no collision - air) or 'cube' (full cube).
solid             Does the block occupy its full cell? Used by the mesher to decide
neighbour culling together with culls_neighbors.
transparent       Visibility passes through (used for face-culling decisions).
NOTE for M00: a VoxelBlockyModelCube can carry only ONE material
(see src/adapters/voxel/block_library_builder.gd MATERIALS block and
tools/probe_materials.gd), and that material must stay opaque or every
block is pushed through the transparent pass. So water is flagged
transparent:true in data and drawn OPAQUE in M00; the builder reports it
under 'translucent_deferred'. True alpha-blended water needs a
VoxelBlockyModelMesh with 2 surfaces - deferred to M04.
collision         'full' = one full-cell AABB, 'none' = no collision mesh.
culls_neighbors   true  = a neighbouring block touching this face is not drawn.
Water/air must be false or the terrain would hide faces behind it.
transparency_index  Passed straight to VoxelBlockyModel.transparency_index (1.7).
tiles             Face -> atlas tile NAME. Face keys are the six VoxelBlockyModel.Side
names (positive_x, negative_x, positive_y, negative_y, positive_z,
negative_z) plus the shortcuts 'side' (all four horizontals) and
'all' (every face). Most specific key wins.
Deferred on purpose in M00 (see docs/reports/M00_REPORT.md section 10):
* leaves are OPAQUE here. Alpha-tested foliage needs a transparency_index/material
pass that belongs to the art lock milestone, not the foundation milestone.
* water uses a plain cube model, NOT VoxelBlockyModelFluid. Fluid levels and flow are
hydrology (M05). Nothing in M00 generates water voxels.
* no block attributes (rotation / axis / fluid level). Those live on
VoxelBlockyTypeLibrary + VoxelBlockyType, which is the 1.7-native path and is the
right base for flora/structures in M09+. Recorded in the report.
